changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE visitor_requests ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
visitor_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, visitor_phone VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, visitor_email VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, purpose VARCHAR(500), rejection_reason VARCHAR(500),
expected_in TIMESTAMPTZ, expected_out TIMESTAMPTZ,
-- OTP-based validation otp_hash VARCHAR(255), otp_generated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, otp_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
-- Status status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
flat_id BIGINT NOT NULL, requested_by_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ, entered_at TIMESTAMPTZ, exited_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
-- Auditing (from AuditableEntity) created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
CONSTRAINT fk_visitor_request_flat FOREIGN KEY (flat_id) REFERENCES flats (id),
CONSTRAINT fk_visitor_request_user FOREIGN KEY (requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) );

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE visitor_requests RENAME COLUMN otp_hash TO otp;
